prime.options.fsr.quality.tooltip: Controls the internal path-tracing resolution. Higher quality preserves more distant detail; higher performance improves frame rate. Changing this safely rebuilds Prime's render history.
prime.options.fsr.debug_view.tooltip: Shows FidelityFX's integration overview for motion, protected history, depth, disocclusion, shading change, and reactive detail. Intended for diagnostics, not normal play.
